prompts: A policy newsletter is running a piece on which of Brazil's anti-inflation plans delivered what it promised, and wants a ranking it can defend. Research the plans in {WS}/RUBRIC.md on the open web: this one needs public sources, and you are allowed to browse. Score every plan with that rubric, rank the top 3, and write a one-page dossier for the editor in {WS}/dossier.md. Every number must carry the URL it came from. Record the result in {WS}/result.json: plans (one entry per plan with plan, launch_date, ipca_before, ipca_after, months_lasted, score and sources, a list of URLs) and top3 (plan names, best first).
answers:
[goal] Rank Brazil’s anti-inflation plans under the supplied rubric.

[action] Wrote the [one-page dossier](./dossier.md) and [machine-readable results](./result.json) using IBGE’s annual IPCA series and documented launch dates. Real’s launch is dated to the day its currency entered circulation.

[result] **Real ranked first, Collor I second, and Collor II third.** Real had the largest proportional inflation decline and received full durability credit. Collor I’s comparison year included Collor II’s launch, which limits how much of the decline can be attributed to Collor I alone. [IBGE annual series](https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf) · [Plan chronology](https://www.bcb.gov.br/pre/sobre/PremioBCB/1_PriceSetting_JuliaAraujoMauroRodrigues.pdf)

[next] Independent recalculation confirmed the saved results. `Verified all six month counts and scores. Ranking: Real, Collor I, Collor II`

--- dossier.md ---
# Which Brazilian inflation plan delivered?

**Real ranks first, followed by Collor I and Collor II.** Real combined the steepest proportional fall in annual inflation with full durability credit. Collor I beat its longer-lived successor because inflation fell further from its starting level. Cruzado, Bresser and Verão earned all their points from time elapsed. [IBGE annual series][ipca] · [Scoring rubric][rules]

| Plan, best first | Launch | Annual IPCA before | Annual IPCA after | Whole months | Score |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Real | [1994-07-01][real] | [1993 · 2,477.15%][ipca] | [1995 · 22.41%][ipca] | [60][rules] | [0.9937][rules] |
| Collor I | [1990-03-16][history] | [1989 · 1,972.91%][ipca] | [1991 · 472.70%][ipca] | [10][history] | [0.5823][rules] |
| Collor II | [1991-01-31][history] | [1990 · 1,620.97%][ipca] | [1992 · 1,119.10%][ipca] | [41][real] | [0.4217][rules] |
| Bresser | [1987-06-12][bresser] | [1986 · 79.66%][ipca] | [1988 · 980.21%][ipca] | [19][verao] | [0.0950][rules] |
| Cruzado | [1986-02-28][history] | [1985 · 242.23%][ipca] | [1987 · 363.41%][ipca] | [15][bresser] | [0.0750][rules] |
| Verão | [1989-01-15][verao] | [1988 · 980.21%][ipca] | [1990 · 1,620.97%][ipca] | [14][history] | [0.0700][rules] |

**Reading the scores.** The [rubric][rules] assigns [70%][rules] to the proportional drop in IPCA, floored at zero and capped at one, and [30%][rules] to completed months as a share of [60][rules]. Each row links the inflation inputs, launch and successor date used in its calculation. Real receives the prescribed [60 months][rules]. The comparison uses the calendar years immediately before and after launch, omitting the launch year.

**Dating choices.** Bresser starts with the minister’s [launch address][bresser], Verão with the [original provisional measure][verao], and Real when the [currency entered circulation][real]. Durability counts monthly anniversaries to the next plan named in the rubric. It measures time to replacement, even if inflation had already revived.

**Editorial caution.** Collor I’s after-year includes the launch of Collor II. Its runner-up score describes a fall across that window, but the comparison cannot establish how much either plan caused. Even Real’s winning after-year still recorded [22.41% inflation][ipca].

[ipca]: https://www.ibge.gov.br/biblioteca/visualizacao/periodicos/236/inpc_ipca_2012_jan.pdf
[history]: https://www.bcb.gov.br/pre/sobre/PremioBCB/1_PriceSetting_JuliaAraujoMauroRodrigues.pdf
[bresser]: https://www.bresserpereira.org.br/index.php/short-texts/7379-572
[verao]: https://www2.camara.leg.br/legin/fed/medpro/1989/medidaprovisoria-32-15-janeiro-1989-370474-publicacaooriginal-1-pe.html
[real]: https://www.bcb.gov.br/controleinflacao/30anosreal?modalAberto=30anosreal_modal_jul94
[rules]: ./RUBRIC.md
